title: Stable and unstable syzygy bundles on certain Picard rank one varieties
summary: If $X$ is a smooth projective variety of dimension $\geq 2$ and Picard rank $1$ on which every ample line bundle has at least $2$ linearly independent sections, we prove that syzygy bundle of any nontrivial globally generated line bundle is stable. We apply this to show stability of syzygy bundles in non-general type complete intersections in weighted projective spaces, and all complete intersections in projective spaces.
